premises.text: Lack of internet on smartphones is a large problem spanning emergencies and economic growth
premises.evidence_span: it can also promote social and economical growth

premises.text: SDK integration brings offline mode to apps people already use
premises.evidence_span: an SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: Bluetooth mesh with hopping extends effective range via intermediate devices
premises.evidence_span: information can hop on devices found in the middle, so the range is increased

premises.text: Algorithm manages flooding, TTL, and battery; product is encrypted and patented with Android-iOS support
premises.evidence_span: The mesh network is powered by our really smart algorithm

premises.text: B2B developer distribution plus MAU-based pricing captures value when offline tech is used
premises.evidence_span: We charge based on monthly active users that use your app thanks to our technology each month

value.text: People stay connected through familiar apps without internet access
value.evidence_span: being able to connect with rescue corps or being able to connect with their teachers

causal_links.evidence_span: when developers make this revenue, we also make it

notes: GTM and pricing merged into one commercial premise this run. Standard-for-offline-comms aspiration not coded.
